title: semvr: npm-style version ranges from a written specification (Python, many small rules)
prompt: `semvr/ranges.py` is a stub. Implement it so that `satisfies`, `max_satisfying`, `min_satisfying` and `is_valid_range` behave exactly as README.md specifies (range syntax, what each term means, the pre-release rule, error handling). Do not change `semvr/version.py`. The tests in `tests/` cover only the common cases; the README is the specification. Run the tests before you finish.
